editorial_thesis: Trustworthy agent capability depends on explicit identity decisions, evidence-bearing dependencies, and workflows that remain useful when intelligence moves closer to the device or physical system.

topic_groups.title: Agent Identity + Authorization
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A fresh MCP authorization pattern makes the policy-enforcement/policy-decision seam concrete; token-exchange measurement adds an operational cost lens.

sources.title: Centralizing MCP Authorization with PingAuthorize - Part 1
sources.why_selected: Shows centralized dynamic authorization for MCP through an API gateway.
sources.usefulness: Provides a reusable PEP/PDP architecture for tool calls.

sources.title: How expensive is a token exchange, really?
sources.why_selected: Offers a concrete load-test lens on RFC 8693 exchange overhead.
sources.usefulness: Suggests latency and cache metrics for agent identity telemetry.

topic_groups.title: Open Source Supply-Chain Readiness
topic_groups.selection_rationale: This fills a coverage gap with practical, role-based CRA guidance and an enterprise participation case rather than another generic OSS roundup.

sources.title: Grow CRA Readiness: Navigating the EU Cyber Resilience Act
sources.why_selected: Maps maintainers, stewards, and manufacturers to different readiness paths.
sources.usefulness: Can become a dependency intake and evidence checklist.

sources.title: How IBM Turns Open Source Participation into Enterprise Value
sources.why_selected: Connects participation with platform strategy and security learning.
sources.usefulness: Frames upstream contribution as risk management and capability building.

topic_groups.title: On-Device Intelligence + Physical Systems
topic_groups.selection_rationale: This deliberately diversifies beyond software-only agents: one near-term device surface, one infrastructure moonshot, and concrete robotics challenge formats.

sources.title: Googlebook’s Built-In Intelligence
sources.why_selected: Packages context-summoned, local, and background assistance into the workstation.

sources.title: Project Suncatcher prototype is in orbit
sources.why_selected: Tests compute infrastructure under physical space constraints.
sources.usefulness: Provides a frame for edge, offline, and degraded-mode architecture.

sources.title: FIRST Global Challenge 2026
sources.why_selected: Makes physical AI concrete through explicit goals, environments, and scoring.
sources.usefulness: Offers a template for bounded agent evaluation workshops.

sources.title: FIRST CANOPY 2026–2027
sources.why_selected: Shows a multi-year robotics curriculum around biodiversity and systems thinking.
sources.usefulness: Supports educational and client-workshop use cases.
